post_text:
Booking Holdings and Expedia Group now take 85.4% of hotel bookings made through online travel agencies in Europe.

The figure comes from the European Hotel Distribution Study by @HOTREC, published on 15 September. It covers 2025 and draws on 2,713 hotels in 28 countries.

Booking Holdings alone holds 68.8%, against about 60% in 2013. Direct bookings now account for 51.3% of hotel bookings, six points less than in 2013. OTAs reach 29.9% of the total.

Price undercutting is also rising: 51% of hotels say an OTA has sold their rooms below their own rate, against 43% in 2023.

The signal: concentration keeps growing even as Brussels tightens rules on large platforms. For luxury hotels, the direct channel is less a habit than a margin to defend.

What share of your bookings comes direct today?
